services.name: ALL DAY WHALE WATCH (8-12hrs)
services.desc: With all day on the water, we have more time to explore the bay, travel offshore, and get to interesting sightings reports! About All Day whale watching trips run 8-12hrs weather permitting. These special trips are limited to ~65% of our passenger capacity for a more comfortable experience. Unlike our weekly whale watching trips, all day trips are not fully narrated over the PA, but several naturalists are on board to answer questions and direct attention to wildlife. Definitely bring food for yourself or to share! There is also a small snack bar on board with small snack items plus sodas, water and coffee. services.name: Extended Whale Watch
services.desc: Do you feel like whale watching trips always end too soon? Then our extended trips are for you! The longer time allows us to spend more time with the animals for better photos, and gives us a higher chance of seeing more species. You should be confident in your seaworthiness (either know you don't get seasick or know how to prevent it) so you can enjoy this long trip! About Enjoy the adventure in comfort on our 60ft luxury yacht, High Spirits. Immaculate and spacious, our boat has plenty of room on the bow, inside the cabin with plenty of windows, and on our observation deck with a bird's eye view of the bay (18yrs+).
